name: Computer Science

prerequisites.rawText: Six Grade 12 U and/or M courses including Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, a Grade 12 U English course, and one other 4U course. Grade 11 U Introduction to Computer Science is recommended.

admissionRange.rawText: Individual selection from the low to mid-90s

supplementary.rawText: The Admission Information Form is required for admission.

description: One of Canada's best-known CS programs, with optional co-op and a wide range of specializations from AI to software engineering.

name: Software Engineering

prerequisites.rawText: Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, Chemistry, Physics, English, and one other 4U/M course.

supplementary.rawText: The Admission Information Form is required for admission. An interview may be requested.

description: A joint program between Engineering and Computer Science focused on building large, reliable software systems. Mandatory co-op.

name: Mechanical Engineering

prerequisites.rawText: Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, Chemistry, Physics, English, and one other 4U/M course.

admissionRange.rawText: Individual selection from the high 80s to low 90s

supplementary.rawText: The Admission Information Form is required for admission.

description: Design, build and analyze machines and energy systems. Mandatory co-op with five work terms.

name: Accounting and Financial Management

prerequisites.rawText: English, Advanced Functions, and one of Calculus and Vectors or Mathematics of Data Management.

supplementary.rawText: The Admission Information Form is required for admission.

description: Prepares students for CPA and finance careers, with co-op placements at major firms.

name: Health Sciences

prerequisites.rawText: English, Biology, Chemistry, and one of Advanced Functions, Calculus and Vectors, or Mathematics of Data Management.

admissionRange.rawText: Individual selection from the low to mid-80s
